rp-farm-01.back: Only with the consent of the owner, lessee or occupant (synopsis page 9).

rp-farm-05.front: What do deer and elk do to fruit trees?
rp-farm-05.back: Chew buds, spurs, shoots and leaves; antler rubbing breaks branches.
